interface.shortDescription: Bring your GTM Brain, leads, signals, and SEO plan into ChatGPT and Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connect your Pancake CMO workspace to ChatGPT and Codex. Ground marketing work in your approved GTM Brain, review qualified leads and lead-finding runs, inspect signal settings and the SEO publication plan, submit lead feedback, and make requested Brain or signal updates. Access is workspace-scoped and authorized through Pancake's browser OAuth flow.
